helloInfo: Welcome to log in to the SOQA system
introDetail: This program is an aircraft flight training program. Only when the instructor confirms that the meteorological conditions meet the requirements of the visual takeoff and landing route can the visual takeoff and landing route program be executed. The altitude of the takeoff and landing route is 450 meters (higher than the airport elevation) or above. If the meteorological conditions do not meet the requirements for visual takeoff and landing routes, it is necessary to refer to instrument flight and meet the instrument stable approach standards. During aircraft flight training, it should be implemented according to the prescribed subjects and deviation correction teaching should not be artificially set.
trainingmodal2: Do not perform any other operations
trainingmodal3: Are you sure to end the training?
trainingmodal4: After completion, the system will upload training data and cannot return to the current training again
